occurrences.opportunityName: Family: Deliver Daily Necessities and Warmth to Homeless Community in YMT
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: On this Yau Ma Tei Kindness Walk, you will see a wide range of individuals in great need and serve roughly 50 homeless individuals. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute necessities including food and drinks to the people in need.

ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity, they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships in the hope of creating opportunities for change. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more.

This walk starts from ImpactHK 's Guest Room, and takes nearly 1.5 hours to complete. Please bring a reusable bag to carry the items to hand out. 


This is a family friendly Kindness Walk.  Parental guidance is required for volunteers under the age of 15. 

Volunteers between the ages of 6 and 14 must be accompanied by an adult to join this Kindness Walk. The guardian must first sign up for this activity. After successful registration, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up. Volunteers between the ages of 15 and 18 who want to join the activity without an adult must obtain prior parental consent and email this to HandsOn Hong Kong in order to successfully register for the activity.

All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.
occurrences.locationCity: Impact Hong Kong Guest Room, 29 Oak St, Tai Kok Tsui

occurrences.organizationServedName: The Hong Kong Virtuoso Chorus Limited
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
活動簡介:  香港校際合唱節於 2026 年 1 月至 2 月將舉行 4 場專場音樂會，我們會邀請 13 隊表現優秀的中、小學合唱團、5 隊社區合唱團，以及 1 隊年席客席合唱團演出，為表演出色的合唱團帶來更多演出機會，增強學生的自信，豐富表演經驗，手為社會帶來高水準的合唱音樂會，增加公眾認同。我們的媒體伙伴香港港台將會轉播部分音樂會。





義工角色：

1、合唱團助手：按活動演出流程引導演出合唱團隊伍。包括：到達、舞台排練、午休、表演和離場。

2. 前台助手：負責前台事務的聯絡，例如解答觀眾查詢、人流控制等

3. 票務助理: 負責處理票務、解答有關票務查詢等



義工條件：


	
喜歡與小朋友相處，對音樂有認識更佳

	
有大型活動人群管理經驗

	
活動前及期間，大會希望邀請義工加入 WhatsApp 群組，以便溝通流程等。希望義工熟悉 Whatsapp 的應用，並於手機上下載 WhatsApp。



 備註:

-有意報名參加這香港校際合唱節2026的活動，義工必須先按此報名參加1月11日的義工簡報會。

-報名截止日期：2026年1月7日





Description: The Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival will present four Signature Concerts in Jan - Feb 2026. We will be inviting 13 outstanding primary and secondary school choirs, 5 community choirs, and 1 Guest Choir of the Year to perform. The aim is to provide exceptional choirs with more performance opportunities, strengthen students’ confidence, enrich their stage experience, and bring high-quality choral concerts to the community, thereby enhancing public recognition of choral arts. Our media partner, RTHK, will broadcast selected performances from these concerts.



Volunteer Roles:

1. Choir Guide: Guide the performing choir teams according to the event performance schedule, including arrival, stage rehearsal, lunch break, performance, and departure.

2. Front of House Liasion: Responsible for front-of-house coordination, such as answering audience inquiries, crowd flow management, etc.

3. Ticketing Usher: Responsible for handling ticketing matters and answering ticketing-related inquiries.



     

Requirements:

1. Enjoy working with children; knowledge of music is a plus;

2. Crowd-management experience is welcomed.

3. It would be preferred if volunteers are comfortable using WhatsApp for pre-event briefing and on-day logistics communication.



Remarks:

-Volunteers interested in participating in the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026 activities must first register HERE for the volunteer briefing session on January 11.

-Registration Deadline: 7/1/2026

occurrences.opportunityName: Re-think Plastic: Volunteer anytime anywhere to help solve excessive waste issue
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

occurrences.description:
Description: At this event you will help to prepare soap donated by hotels for recycling and distribution to underprivileged families and schools in disadvantaged communities around the world, particularly in Asia. Your help in the recycling of soaps from hotels in Hong Kong also promotes environmental protection. Volunteers will help with sorting, carving and recycling soap. Guidance will be given by Soap Cycling staff.

All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members who wish to join are warmly welcome—please ensure that each person registers and signs up separately.

Volunteers should be at least 12 years of age to attend this activity without a parent or guardian. Volunteers want to bring their children who age over 7, please create children 's account and sign them up along with your registration or send us an email to HOHK@handsonhongkong.org to register. 

The numbers for this activity are strictly limited so please note that it will not be possible for any non-registered family members or friends to join you.​

Please note that Soap Cycling does not accept kids younger than 7 years-old.

Sessions will be canceled in the short time due to availability of the schedule as well as the sign up numbers (Min 5).

Join us at Love 21 Living Room to support families with special needs! We are looking for a dedicated volunteer to help ensure our community enjoys a warm, organized lunch service.

Volunteer roles:





	
To greet family participants

	
To take attendance

	
To portion food for participants

	
To use microwaves to heat meals

	
To serve meals to participants

	
To clean up food containers, rice cookers and microwaves







Language requirements for volunteers: Fluent in Cantonese (preferred but not required) 

All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members who wish to join are warmly welcome—please ensure that each person registers and signs up separately.

To be comfortable with playing Soft Darts. 

	
To be able to lead a subgroup independently.

occurrences.opportunityName: Help Out with Beach Cleaning in Cheung Sha Lan (children under 13)
occurrences.organizationServedName: Plastic Free Seas 無塑海洋
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Note: All parents and friends of children attending a beach cleanup MUST be signed up. Do NOT only sign up a child. Please sign up adults and children aged 13 and above first on the adult calendar event, then sign up children under 13 on this calendar event. Remember that all adults and children must be registered to attend. 

Description: Plastic Free Seas and DB Green are cohosting a community beach cleanup. Gloves and bags will be provided. Volunteers must wear closed-toe shoes, a hat, bring a full reusable water bottle, sun protection and bug spray.    

Remarks: Experienced staff will be on hand to make this an interesting and educational experience for volunteers. There will be a safety and instruction brief at the start, and a debrief at the end. Note there are no toilets or shops at the beach.

Volunteers are expected to refrain from bringing single-use items to the beach, such as disposable plastic bottles, rain coats, etc. 

Directions: Take the 1.30 ferry (or earlier) from Central Ferry Pier #3, or DB03R bus from Sunny Bay station. Walk 5 min walk from the ferry pier / bus terminal to the meeting point at the entrance to Nim Shue Wan. You can find a map and directions here to get to the meeting point at Nim Shue Wan. 
Use the toilet on the ferry or at the plaza before coming to the meeting point as there are NO toilet facilities at the beach.

Upon arrival, let the staff know that you are with HandsOn HK. The group will depart at 2.10pm for the beach which is a further easy 10 min walk away. You can find a map to the meeting point here. If you are late, follow the path towards Mui Wo and you will get to Cheung Sha Lan.

Please be reminded that all participants must be signed up for this event, including adults and children. Volunteers should not bring along a friend or family member who has not signed up.

Children under 13 years must be accompanied by an adult for this program. Children age 6-12 must create an individual volunteer account and sign up through this page. Volunteers who want to bring their children under the age of 6, please email their names and ages to HOHK@handsonhongkong.org. 

If you register minimum 10 days before the event and plan to travel by ferry from Central Ferry Pier #3 to DB, your return trip will be free of charge if arrangements are made ahead of time. The free ferry ride must be used on the same day as the beach cleanup. Volunteers are not eligible for the free ferry tickets when you claim the vacancy spot from the waiting list less than 10 days before the event.

Volunteers will receive a detailed service reminder email one day before the event, along with a letter for the free ferry ticket.

Remarks: Most of the charity partners are now facing a challenging funding landscape. Increased demand for services – due to funding reductions within the sector – coupled with reduced funding opportunities, from corporate engagements to grants, has created a critical need for support. Furthermore, rising operational costs, driven by inflation and other economic factors, mean that we require increased funding to simply maintain the current level of service.

Therefore, to ensure the stream of funding from engaging corporate partners and the best interactive volunteering experiences for everyone, the service sessions open at the HandsOn platform are only for individual participation.

If you and your friends from the same company wish to participate together, we recommend keeping your group size to no more than 3-5 people. Additionally, we kindly ask that you refrain from sharing or engaging in any promotional activities related to your company during the activity.

For companies ' engagement, please contact Plastic Free Seas.


All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately. Parents accompanying their children must also be signed up as volunteers.

occurrences.opportunityName: Be a supporter at HKICF 2026 Competition cum Masterclass
occurrences.organizationServedName: The Hong Kong Virtuoso Chorus Limited
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
活動簡介: 比賽暨大師班為香港校際合唱節旗艦活動，我們在比賽形式上另闢蹊徑，強調參賽隊伍並非競爭對手，而是共同學習的對象和夥伴。隊伍可以自由選擇任何曲目參賽，只要表現能夠達到金、銀、銅既定的級別標准，即可獲取該級別獎項。在每隊演唱後，專家評判會即時上台給予意見及指導該合唱團如何改善當中的缺漏，並讓該團隊在專業指導後，再次演繹該選段。在這樣的安排下，在場參賽的各隊伍都能得知客觀的評審標准，亦能學到以不同角度賞析合唱音樂，提升藝術鑒賞能力。 



受眾為喜愛音樂的香港中小學生。香港校際合唱節2026會在1-2月份舉辦共34場比賽暨大師班，每場會為約500-700名中小學生提供國際水準合唱音樂教育機會。



義工角色：

1、合唱團助手：按活動演出流程引導演出合唱團隊伍。包括：到達、舞台排練、午休、表演和離場。

2. 前台助手：負責前台事務的聯絡，例如解答觀眾查詢、人流控制等

3. 票務助理: 負責處理票務、解答有關票務查詢等



義工條件：


	
喜歡與小朋友相處，對音樂有認識更佳

	
有大型活動人群管理經驗

	
活動前及期間，大會希望邀請義工加入 WhatsApp 群組，以便溝通流程等。希望義工熟悉 Whatsapp 的應用，並於手機上下載 WhatsApp。



 備註:

-有意報名參加這香港校際合唱節2026的活動，義工必須先按此報名參加1月11日的義工簡報會。

-報名截止日期：2026年1月7日





Description: Competition cum Masterclass is the flagship event of the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival. We have adopted an alternative approach to the traditional competition format, emphasising that participating choirs are not rivals, but partners in a shared learning experience. Choirs may freely choose any repertoire for their performance, and awards are granted based on whether the ensemble meets the established standards for Gold, Silver, or Bronze levels. After each choir’s performance, the expert adjudicator will come on stage to provide immediate comments and guidance on how the ensemble can improve. The choir will then re-perform a selected section under the adjudicator’s professional coaching. Through this format, all participating groups gain insight into objective evaluation criteria, while also learning to appreciate choral music from different perspectives, thereby enhancing their artistic understanding and musical appreciation.





The target audience is primary and secondary school students in Hong Kong who love music. The Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026  will be held in January and February, featuring a total of 34 competition sessions and masterclasses. Each session will provide approximately 500–700 primary and secondary students with international-standard choral music education opportunities.



Volunteer Roles:

1. Choir Guide: Guide the performing choir teams according to the event performance schedule, including arrival, stage rehearsal, lunch break, performance, and departure.

2. Front of House Liasion: Responsible for front-of-house coordination, such as answering audience inquiries, crowd flow management, etc.

3. Ticketing Usher: Responsible for handling ticketing matters and answering ticketing-related inquiries.



     

Requirements:

1. Enjoy working with children; knowledge of music is a plus;

2. Crowd-management experience is welcomed.

3. It would be preferred if volunteers are comfortable using WhatsApp for pre-event briefing and on-day logistics communication.



Remarks:

-Volunteers interested in participating in the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026 activities must first register HERE for the volunteer briefing session on January 11.

-Registration Deadline: 7/1/2026

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
FOODSPORT Wednesday

Description: “FOODSPORT WEDNESDAY” is the weekly recurring calorie drive, taking place virtually so all can participate, regardless of location. This program aims to inject some mid-week motivation for everyone to get active before the weekend. All you have to do is track your hard-earned calories and share the data on our one-of-a-kind online calorie drive platform. The campaign runs from Tuesdays at 1800 to Thursdays at 1800. Together, let’s liven up our weeks and make every drop of sweat count!



FEES: FREE



CALORIE CALCULATION METHOD: Use any type of calorie tracking device to help you track your calorie-burning record during exercise.



Volunteer Roles:

1. HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' exercising efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below, you are committing to exercise anytime and anywhere from Tuesday, 6 pm to Thursday, 6 pm.



2. Click here: https://www.foodsport.com.hk/fswednesday to follow the Submission Record Method procedures to submit your calorie-burnt record to FoodSport.



3. Within 14 days of your registered session, send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

Description: LOVE 21 is a charity dedicated to bettering the lives of those living with Down syndrome and autism in Hong Kong through physical activity and nutrition. They run a variety of sport and exercise classes, a health and nutrition programme, and guardian counselling and workshops. 

Volunteer roles:





	
To be comfortable with playing general sports. 

	
To be able to lead a subgroup independently.

	
To assist the Sports Instructor in teaching a group of 8-12 children or people aged 6-45 and with Down Syndrome and to be confident enough to practice with the students when the coach is working with other students.

	
To assist the instructor in helping the class run smoothly and safely, while also ensuring that everyone is actively engaged.

	
To motivate and energize participants throughout the class.

	
Please wear appropriate sports clothing and footwear as you will be actively participating as well. 







Language requirements for volunteers: Fluent in Cantonese (preferred but not required) 

All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members who wish to join are warmly welcome—please ensure that each person registers and signs up separately.

occurrences.opportunityName: Save bread for the less fortunate Tsim Sha Tsui Mondays  (Youth Welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HKFoodWorks
occurrences.description:
Description: Everyday in Hong Kong, over 3,250 tonnes of food waste are dumped into landfills, while one in five people live in poverty and struggle to eat.





Breadline is Hong Kong’s first public digital platform for food rescue. Volunteers connect with bakeries on Breadline to rescue leftover bread using real-time updates to make every run count.





Together, we save resources from being wasted and we support the homeless; low-income families; refugees and their children and the elderly poor, by delivering bread the same night to our grassroots partners.

 



 Important first step: To participate, you must sign up on the Breadline platform and secure your chosen bakeries ahead of time. Bakery slots are highly competitive and operate strictly on a first-come, first-served basis—they go fast, so book your run early!





Volunteer Role:



Save bread!



- Choose your own runs on Breadline by selecting the bakeries you want to collect from



- Check-in for real-time updates and bring your own bags to collect



- Be agile and flexible, go to where the bread is!





Service time: Pick-up time is the one stated for your shop. You can drop-off your collection at Tsim Sha Tsui The One Shopping Mall from 8:15 pm to 9:15 pm. Volunteers will be there to welcome you with your haul.



If you sign up as a team, each teammate should claim their own runs. 





Service details and volunteer safety: All volunteers will receive a service reminder for this activity which must be followed exactly to ensure timely bread collection and handling guidelines are followed.

occurrences.locationZipCode: 尖沙咀區

occurrences.opportunityName: Deliver Necessities and Warmth to Homeless Community in Yau Ma Tei
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description:On this Yau Ma Tei Kindness Walk, you will see a wide range of individuals in great need and serve roughly 35 people experiencing homelessness. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute snacks and necessities to people in need.
 
ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity, they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships in the hope of creating opportunities for change. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more.
 
This walk gathers at a shop in Jordan and takes 2 hours to complete. Bring a reusable bag to carry the items to hand out.
 
Parental guidance is required for volunteers under the age of 16. We do not suggest this walk for children under 10.  
 
All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.

 
Remarks: Volunteers between the ages of 10 and 14 must be accompanied by an adult to join this Kindness Walk. The guardian must first sign up for this activity. After successful registration, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up. Volunteers between the ages of 15 and 18 who want to join the activity without an adult must obtain prior parental consent and email this to HandsOn Hong Kong in order to successfully register for the activity.

occurrences.opportunityName: Be a supporter at HKICF 2026 Competition cum Masterclass
occurrences.organizationServedName: The Hong Kong Virtuoso Chorus Limited
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
活動簡介: 比賽暨大師班為香港校際合唱節旗艦活動，我們在比賽形式上另闢蹊徑，強調參賽隊伍並非競爭對手，而是共同學習的對象和夥伴。隊伍可以自由選擇任何曲目參賽，只要表現能夠達到金、銀、銅既定的級別標准，即可獲取該級別獎項。在每隊演唱後，專家評判會即時上台給予意見及指導該合唱團如何改善當中的缺漏，並讓該團隊在專業指導後，再次演繹該選段。在這樣的安排下，在場參賽的各隊伍都能得知客觀的評審標准，亦能學到以不同角度賞析合唱音樂，提升藝術鑒賞能力。 



受眾為喜愛音樂的香港中小學生。香港校際合唱節2026會在1-2月份舉辦共34場比賽暨大師班，每場會為約500-700名中小學生提供國際水準合唱音樂教育機會。



義工角色：

1、合唱團助手：按活動演出流程引導演出合唱團隊伍。包括：到達、舞台排練、午休、表演和離場。

2. 前台助手：負責前台事務的聯絡，例如解答觀眾查詢、人流控制等

3. 票務助理: 負責處理票務、解答有關票務查詢等



義工條件：


	
喜歡與小朋友相處，對音樂有認識更佳

	
有大型活動人群管理經驗

	
活動前及期間，大會希望邀請義工加入 WhatsApp 群組，以便溝通流程等。希望義工熟悉 Whatsapp 的應用，並於手機上下載 WhatsApp。



 備註:

-有意報名參加這香港校際合唱節2026的活動，義工必須先按此報名參加1月11日的義工簡報會。

-報名截止日期：2026年1月7日





Description: Competition cum Masterclass is the flagship event of the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival. We have adopted an alternative approach to the traditional competition format, emphasising that participating choirs are not rivals, but partners in a shared learning experience. Choirs may freely choose any repertoire for their performance, and awards are granted based on whether the ensemble meets the established standards for Gold, Silver, or Bronze levels. After each choir’s performance, the expert adjudicator will come on stage to provide immediate comments and guidance on how the ensemble can improve. The choir will then re-perform a selected section under the adjudicator’s professional coaching. Through this format, all participating groups gain insight into objective evaluation criteria, while also learning to appreciate choral music from different perspectives, thereby enhancing their artistic understanding and musical appreciation.





The target audience is primary and secondary school students in Hong Kong who love music. The Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026  will be held in January and February, featuring a total of 34 competition sessions and masterclasses. Each session will provide approximately 500–700 primary and secondary students with international-standard choral music education opportunities.



Volunteer Roles:

1. Choir Guide: Guide the performing choir teams according to the event performance schedule, including arrival, stage rehearsal, lunch break, performance, and departure.

2. Front of House Liasion: Responsible for front-of-house coordination, such as answering audience inquiries, crowd flow management, etc.

3. Ticketing Usher: Responsible for handling ticketing matters and answering ticketing-related inquiries.



     

Requirements:

1. Enjoy working with children; knowledge of music is a plus;

2. Crowd-management experience is welcomed.

3. It would be preferred if volunteers are comfortable using WhatsApp for pre-event briefing and on-day logistics communication.



Remarks:

-Volunteers interested in participating in the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026 activities must first register HERE for the volunteer briefing session on January 11.

-Registration Deadline: 7/1/2026

occurrences.opportunityName: Help and Deliver Your Care at Paws United Charity Dog Adoption Centre
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Paws United Charity (PUC) is a non-profit, all-volunteer rescue organization established and registered in Hong Kong (ORG00102).

 

A group of animal-loving volunteers who are passionate about animal rescue and have worked together across various rescue projects in Hong Kong. After many years of hard work and dedication, they finally have a ‘home’ to call their own.



Volunteer roles:

1. Taking care and socializing with puppies

2. Cleansing

3. Assisting visitors by introducing Paws United Charity and the puppies to them



This will serve PUC’s core mission to continue to improve the lives of animals in our community by promoting responsible pet ownership, humane treatment of animals, and choosing adoption instead of purchase. 



Important Note: Please be aware that some dogs, particularly puppies, are very energetic and at times, boisterous. Volunteers should be comfortable handling dogs with this level of energy and enthusiasm, and we recommend wearing appropriate clothing (as detailed below) to minimise nips or scratches. 



Remarks:


	
Only successfully registered volunteers for this activity are allowed to join this activity. Please DO NOT bring any unregistered volunteers, your kids, or pets to volunteer.

	
Clothing:

occurrences.opportunityName: Be a supporter at HKICF 2026 Competition cum Masterclass
occurrences.organizationServedName: The Hong Kong Virtuoso Chorus Limited
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
活動簡介: 比賽暨大師班為香港校際合唱節旗艦活動，我們在比賽形式上另闢蹊徑，強調參賽隊伍並非競爭對手，而是共同學習的對象和夥伴。隊伍可以自由選擇任何曲目參賽，只要表現能夠達到金、銀、銅既定的級別標准，即可獲取該級別獎項。在每隊演唱後，專家評判會即時上台給予意見及指導該合唱團如何改善當中的缺漏，並讓該團隊在專業指導後，再次演繹該選段。在這樣的安排下，在場參賽的各隊伍都能得知客觀的評審標准，亦能學到以不同角度賞析合唱音樂，提升藝術鑒賞能力。 



受眾為喜愛音樂的香港中小學生。香港校際合唱節2026會在1-2月份舉辦共34場比賽暨大師班，每場會為約500-700名中小學生提供國際水準合唱音樂教育機會。



義工角色：

1、合唱團助手：按活動演出流程引導演出合唱團隊伍。包括：到達、舞台排練、午休、表演和離場。

2. 前台助手：負責前台事務的聯絡，例如解答觀眾查詢、人流控制等

3. 票務助理: 負責處理票務、解答有關票務查詢等



義工條件：


	
喜歡與小朋友相處，對音樂有認識更佳

	
有大型活動人群管理經驗

	
活動前及期間，大會希望邀請義工加入 WhatsApp 群組，以便溝通流程等。希望義工熟悉 Whatsapp 的應用，並於手機上下載 WhatsApp。



 備註:

-有意報名參加這香港校際合唱節2026的活動，義工必須先按此報名參加1月11日的義工簡報會。

-報名截止日期：2026年1月7日





Description: Competition cum Masterclass is the flagship event of the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival. We have adopted an alternative approach to the traditional competition format, emphasising that participating choirs are not rivals, but partners in a shared learning experience. Choirs may freely choose any repertoire for their performance, and awards are granted based on whether the ensemble meets the established standards for Gold, Silver, or Bronze levels. After each choir’s performance, the expert adjudicator will come on stage to provide immediate comments and guidance on how the ensemble can improve. The choir will then re-perform a selected section under the adjudicator’s professional coaching. Through this format, all participating groups gain insight into objective evaluation criteria, while also learning to appreciate choral music from different perspectives, thereby enhancing their artistic understanding and musical appreciation.





The target audience is primary and secondary school students in Hong Kong who love music. The Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026  will be held in January and February, featuring a total of 34 competition sessions and masterclasses. Each session will provide approximately 500–700 primary and secondary students with international-standard choral music education opportunities.



Volunteer Roles:

1. Choir Guide: Guide the performing choir teams according to the event performance schedule, including arrival, stage rehearsal, lunch break, performance, and departure.

2. Front of House Liasion: Responsible for front-of-house coordination, such as answering audience inquiries, crowd flow management, etc.

3. Ticketing Usher: Responsible for handling ticketing matters and answering ticketing-related inquiries.



     

Requirements:

1. Enjoy working with children; knowledge of music is a plus;

2. Crowd-management experience is welcomed.

3. It would be preferred if volunteers are comfortable using WhatsApp for pre-event briefing and on-day logistics communication.



Remarks:

-Volunteers interested in participating in the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026 activities must first register HERE for the volunteer briefing session on January 11.

-Registration Deadline: 7/1/2026

受眾為喜愛音樂的香港中小學生。香港校際合唱節2026會在1-2月份舉辦共34場比賽暨大師班，每場會為約500-700名中小學生提供國際水準合唱音樂教育機會。



義工角色：

1、合唱團助手：按活動演出流程引導演出合唱團隊伍。包括：到達、舞台排練、午休、表演和離場。

2. 前台助手：負責前台事務的聯絡，例如解答觀眾查詢、人流控制等

3. 票務助理: 負責處理票務、解答有關票務查詢等



義工條件：


	
喜歡與小朋友相處，對音樂有認識更佳

	
有大型活動人群管理經驗

	
活動前及期間，大會希望邀請義工加入 WhatsApp 群組，以便溝通流程等。希望義工熟悉 Whatsapp 的應用，並於手機上下載 WhatsApp。



 備註:

-有意報名參加這香港校際合唱節2026的活動，義工必須先按此報名參加1月11日的義工簡報會。

-報名截止日期：2026年1月7日





Description: Competition cum Masterclass is the flagship event of the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival. We have adopted an alternative approach to the traditional competition format, emphasising that participating choirs are not rivals, but partners in a shared learning experience. Choirs may freely choose any repertoire for their performance, and awards are granted based on whether the ensemble meets the established standards for Gold, Silver, or Bronze levels. After each choir’s performance, the expert adjudicator will come on stage to provide immediate comments and guidance on how the ensemble can improve. The choir will then re-perform a selected section under the adjudicator’s professional coaching. Through this format, all participating groups gain insight into objective evaluation criteria, while also learning to appreciate choral music from different perspectives, thereby enhancing their artistic understanding and musical appreciation.





The target audience is primary and secondary school students in Hong Kong who love music. The Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026  will be held in January and February, featuring a total of 34 competition sessions and masterclasses. Each session will provide approximately 500–700 primary and secondary students with international-standard choral music education opportunities.



Volunteer Roles:

1. Choir Guide: Guide the performing choir teams according to the event performance schedule, including arrival, stage rehearsal, lunch break, performance, and departure.

2. Front of House Liasion: Responsible for front-of-house coordination, such as answering audience inquiries, crowd flow management, etc.

3. Ticketing Usher: Responsible for handling ticketing matters and answering ticketing-related inquiries.



     

Requirements:

1. Enjoy working with children; knowledge of music is a plus;

2. Crowd-management experience is welcomed.

3. It would be preferred if volunteers are comfortable using WhatsApp for pre-event briefing and on-day logistics communication.



Remarks:

-Volunteers interested in participating in the Hong Kong Inter-School Choral Festival 2026 activities must first register HERE for the volunteer briefing session on January 11.

-Registration Deadline: 7/1/2026

occurrences.opportunityName: Packing & sorting food in Tuen Mun for Hong Kong 's most vulnerable
occurrences.organizationServedName: Youth With A Mission Tuen Mun Hong Kong
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description:  Job losses and financial hardships have led to a notable rise in families seeking assistance from charities for essential food needs. YWAM Tuen Mun actively collects surplus dry and fresh food from a variety of donors, receiving both regular and ad-hoc contributions, including items nearing their shelf life and generous donations from partners.

Volunteers will conduct a thorough quality check and sorting process for these donations in the warehouse. They carefully record and evaluate how the food will be redistributed to partner charities and feeding programs that support at-risk elderly individuals, underprivileged children, and low-income families.




Volunteer roles:



	
Volunteers will attend a short briefing at the start of the session and have a clear overview of the food bank and its operations. 

	
Inventory checking, sorting food, labelling, packing items (eg. rice packing, mask packing etc), cleaning, and preparing for the food assistance programs. 



  



All volunteers who attend this activity must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. If you wish to have a friend or family member join you on this activity, they must first register with Hands On and sign up for the activity.

occurrences.opportunityName: Re-think Plastic: Volunteer anytime anywhere to help solve excessive waste issue
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: On this Mong Kok Kindness Walk, you will see a wide range of individuals in great need and serve roughly 35 people experiencing homelessness. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute snacks and necessities to people in need.

ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity, they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships in the hope of creating opportunities for change. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more.

This walk starts from ImpactHK’s centre, The Guestroom, and takes 1 hour to complete.  Please bring a reusable bag to carry the items to hand out. 

Remarks: 
-Volunteers between the ages of 10 and 14 must be accompanied by an adult to join this Kindness Walk. The guardian must first sign up for this activity. After successful registration, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up. 
-Volunteers between the ages of 15 and 18 who want to join the activity without an adult must obtain prior parental consent and email this to hohk@handsonhongkong.org in order to successfully register for the activity.


All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.

occurrences.opportunityName: Save bread for the less fortunate HK Island Wednesdays (Youth Welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HKFoodWorks
occurrences.description:
Description: Everyday in Hong Kong, over 3,250 tonnes of food waste are dumped into landfills, while one in five people live in poverty and struggle to eat.





Breadline is Hong Kong’s first public digital platform for food rescue. Volunteers connect with bakeries on Breadline to rescue leftover bread using real-time updates to make every run count.





Together, we save resources from being wasted and we support the homeless; low-income families; refugees and their children and the elderly poor, by delivering bread the same night to our grassroots partners.



 Important first step: To participate, you must sign up on the Breadline platform and secure your chosen bakeries ahead of time. Bakery slots are highly competitive and operate strictly on a first-come, first-served basis—they go fast, so book your run early!





Volunteer Role:



Save bread!



- Choose your own runs on Breadline by selecting the bakeries you want to collect from



- Check-in for real-time updates and bring your own bags to collect



- Be agile and flexible, go to where the bread is!





Service time: Pick-up time is the one stated for your shop. You can drop-off your collection in Nan Dao Commercial Building, Sheung Wan from 8:30pm to 9:30pm. Volunteers will be there to welcome you with your haul.



If you sign up as a team, each teammate should claim their own runs. 





Service details and volunteer safety: All volunteers will receive a service reminder for this activity which must be followed exactly to ensure timely bread collection and handling guidelines are followed.
occurrences.locationCity: Kowloon & Hong Kong Island
occurrences.locationZipCode: 九龍及香港島

Description: In Hong Kong, 3,600 tonnes of food are discarded daily, while one in five people struggles to access nutritious meals. In response to this urgent need, Feeding Hong Kong 's Bread Runs mobilise dedicated volunteers to collect surplus fresh bread and quality food from local stores near closing time. Volunteers play a crucial role in addressing hunger and reducing food waste in our community, helping us sustain this vital work.

These bread donations are redistributed the same night or first thing the following morning to local charities feeding people in need including shelters for the homeless, migrant workers, refugee support centres, children 's homes and other non-profits supporting the vulnerable.    

Volunteers will work in teams of two to support Feeding Hong Kong’s Bread Run and collect food items from a store in  AIA Tower, Fortress Hill. And then deliver these items immediately to their Yau Tong warehouse.

occurrences.opportunityName: Help Sort through Second-hand Clothing with Environmental NGO Redress
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Did you know that in Hong Kong we dump around 170 tonnes of clothes in our landfills every day, equivalent to around 1.2 million t-shirts? There’s no getting away from it, the fashion industry is hugely polluting. 
 
Redress is a pioneering Hong Kong environmental charity with a mission to educate and empower the fashion industry and consumers to reduce clothings negative environmental impact by shifting to circular solutions. One of the ways we do this is by increasing the re-sale, re-use and recycling of clothing. Through our Clothing Takeback Programme, we collect unwanted clothing from Hong Kongers, and then carefully sort it together with volunteers in order to redistribute it for re-sale at Redress ' secondhand stores, re-use by those in need in our community through our work with 10+ local charity partners, or recycling. Our careful sorting process maximises the value of each item, better supports our charity partners by matching clothing with their specific needs, and reduces wastage.
 
As a part of the community and consumers, you can join our work in circular fashion by participating in our regular "sorting sessions ".
 
Volunteer roles:
1. Help to unbox secondhand clothing donations into the sorting area.
2. Help to carefully sort secondhand clothing donations into 15 categories based on the item 's type and condition.
3. Help to weigh boxes of sorted clothing and move them to the ‘OUT’ area.
4. Help to tidy-up the sorting area at the end of the session.
 
Remarks:
1. The duration of each session is 3 hours (including 15 mins briefing; 15 mins short break and review; 5 mins reflection)
2. Redress will provide safety and hygiene equipment (include gloves, masks, hand sanitizers, first aid kit, etc)
3. Please dress casually with closed-toe shoes and bring your own drinking water.
4. Volunteers are required to fill in the health declaration form on site.
5. Redress staff or the media may take photos or videos to record the activity for the purpose of sharing and promoting the charity’s work. Please inform a staff member on-site if you are uncomfortable with being photographed.

Remarks: Most of the charity partners are now facing a challenging funding landscape. Increased demand for services – due to funding reductions within the sector – coupled with reduced funding opportunities, from corporate engagements to grants, has created a critical need for support. Furthermore, rising operational costs, driven by inflation and other economic factors, mean that we require increased funding to simply maintain the current level of service.

Therefore, to ensure the stream of funding from engaging corporate partners and the best interactive volunteering experiences for everyone, the service sessions open at the HandsOn platform are only for individual participation.

If you and your friends from the same company wish to participate together, we recommend keeping your group size to no more than 3-5 people. Additionally, we kindly ask that you refrain from sharing or engaging in any promotional activities related to your company during the activity.

For companies ' engagement, please contact Redress directly here.

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description:

The Amber Foundation invites you to support their “The Toiletries Project”, a key initiative dedicated to providing essential hygiene items to vulnerable and less resourced communities across Hong Kong.



Access to basic toiletries is fundamental to health, yet it remains a challenge for many. This project fills that gap by collecting, assembling, and distributing vital hygiene kits to those in looking for support, including women in shelters, domestic workers, individuals living on the streets, elderly, and refugee communities. The foundation utilises donated items, such as airline amenity kits and hotel toiletries, to maximize resources and minimize waste.



By volunteering, you’ll play a direct role in fostering health, dignity, and a sense of care for our beneficiaries. Your participation also helps create a fun environment on the day!  



Volunteer Roles


	
Sorting and Categorising: Unpack and categorise a variety of incoming donated items, including individual and bulk toiletries, as well as specific items like airline kits.

	
Assemble the donation hygiene kits according to a specified checklist.





Remarks:

-Volunteers aged 12 to 15 must be accompanied by a legal guardian (for individual sign-ups) or an adult supervisor (for group registrations). To register a minor, the guardian must first sign up for the activity themselves; once registered, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up for the session (Please ensure there is still an available spot for the child before emailing us.).

-Volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.

occurrences.opportunityName: Save bread for the less fortunate Tseung Kwan O Fridays (Youth Welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HKFoodWorks
occurrences.description:
Description: Everyday in Hong Kong, over 3,250 tonnes of food waste are dumped into landfills, while one in five people live in poverty and struggle to eat.





Breadline is Hong Kong’s first public digital platform for food rescue. Volunteers connect with bakeries on Breadline to rescue leftover bread using real-time updates to make every run count.





Together, we save resources from being wasted and we support the homeless; low-income families; refugees and their children and the elderly poor, by delivering bread the same night to our grassroots partners.



 Important first step: To participate, you must sign up on the Breadline platform and secure your chosen bakeries ahead of time. Bakery slots are highly competitive and operate strictly on a first-come, first-served basis—they go fast, so book your run early!





Volunteer Role:



Save bread!



- Choose your own runs on Breadline by selecting the bakeries you want to collect from



- Check-in for real-time updates and bring your own bags to collect



- Be agile and flexible, go to where the bread is!





Service time: Pick-up time is the one stated for your shop. You can drop-off your collection in Hang Hau TKO Gateway (Hang Hau MTR Exit A1) by Circle K / Momok from 9:00pm to 10:00pm. Volunteers will be there to welcome you with your haul.



If you sign up as a team, each teammate should claim their own runs. 





Service details and volunteer safety: All volunteers will receive a service reminder for this activity which must be followed exactly to ensure timely bread collection and handling guidelines are followed.

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: On this Fortress Hill Kindness Walk, you will be serving roughly 18 homeless individuals and a large community of elderly and street cleaners. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute necessities including food, drink, masks and sanitizer to the people in need.

ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships is giving people a true second chance. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more. 

This walk takes roughly one hour and finishes near the North Point MTR.

occurrences.opportunityName: Phone call support to 1 elderly individual [PRE-TRAINED VOLUNTEERS ONLY]
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Each volunteer joining this support-program must have attended our information session before and be available to support ONE elderly individual, by making one phone call each week over a four-week period.
 
First phone calls will be made on Saturday Oct 1st—after then a suitable day and time for calling will be determined between the volunteer and the elderly person they are supporting. Once you signed up for the June 18th session, it means that you 're available for the four-week period and our staff will help you sign up for the remaining three sessions (this is important for our tracking purposes).

Description: Many elderly residents in Hong Kong struggle with social isolation, as they become disconnected from their families and communities. Without regular visitors or conversation, the effects of loneliness can be severe for this vulnerable population, including increased risk of anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline. Help from the city 's volunteers is needed to provide companionship and support for Hong Kong 's isolated elderly residents.


Volunteer roles: Each volunteer will be assigned one elderly individual to call on the phone and check in with once a week. They will provide social connection and emotional support and help their district’s elderly centre to determine their well-being and immediate needs.

All volunteers who attend this activity must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong.

occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: This Chinese New Year, volunteers are invited to join the “Co-create for GOOD – Hand in Hand” program to bring warmth, joy, and festive spirit to children, teenagers, and elderly community members. Together with JCI Hong Kong Jayceettes, you will help create a welcoming environment where participants of different ages can connect, feel cared for, and enjoy meaningful holiday activities.

Volunteers will chat with elderly participants, inviting them to share childhood toy stories while you also share your own memories of both traditional and modern toys (such as spinning tops, marbles, toy cars, and teddy bears), helping to spark connections. During the event, volunteers will split into three teams to visit elderly residents in three housing estates in the Eastern District, delivering Chinese New Year goodie bags and festive blessings to those who may be more isolated.

All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members who wish to join are warmly welcome—please ensure that each person registers and signs up separately.

occurrences.opportunityName: FOODSPORT Exercise for Hunger: Volunteer anytime anywhere
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
FOODSPORT Wednesday

Description: “FOODSPORT WEDNESDAY” is the weekly recurring calorie drive, taking place virtually so all can participate, regardless of location. This program aims to inject some mid-week motivation for everyone to get active before the weekend. All you have to do is track your hard-earned calories and share the data on our one-of-a-kind online calorie drive platform. The campaign runs from Tuesdays at 1800 to Thursdays at 1800. Together, let’s liven up our weeks and make every drop of sweat count!



FEES: FREE



CALORIE CALCULATION METHOD: Use any type of calorie tracking device to help you track your calorie-burning record during exercise.



Volunteer Roles:

1. HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' exercising efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below, you are committing to exercise anytime and anywhere from Tuesday, 6 pm to Thursday, 6 pm.



2. Click here: https://www.foodsport.com.hk/fswednesday to follow the Submission Record Method procedures to submit your calorie-burnt record to FoodSport.



3. Within 14 days of your registered session, send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description:On this Yau Ma Tei Kindness Walk, you will see a wide range of individuals in great need and serve roughly 35 people experiencing homelessness. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute snacks and necessities to people in need.
 
ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity, they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships in the hope of creating opportunities for change. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more.
 
This walk gathers at a shop in Jordan and takes 2 hours to complete. Bring a reusable bag to carry the items to hand out.
 
Parental guidance is required for volunteers under the age of 16. We do not suggest this walk for children under 10.  
 
All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.

 
Remarks: Volunteers between the ages of 10 and 14 must be accompanied by an adult to join this Kindness Walk. The guardian must first sign up for this activity. After successful registration, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up. Volunteers between the ages of 15 and 18 who want to join the activity without an adult must obtain prior parental consent and email this to HandsOn Hong Kong in order to successfully register for the activity.

occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

occurrences.opportunityName: Save bread for the less fortunate HK Island Wednesdays (Youth Welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HKFoodWorks
occurrences.description:
Description: Everyday in Hong Kong, over 3,250 tonnes of food waste are dumped into landfills, while one in five people live in poverty and struggle to eat.





Breadline is Hong Kong’s first public digital platform for food rescue. Volunteers connect with bakeries on Breadline to rescue leftover bread using real-time updates to make every run count.





Together, we save resources from being wasted and we support the homeless; low-income families; refugees and their children and the elderly poor, by delivering bread the same night to our grassroots partners.



 Important first step: To participate, you must sign up on the Breadline platform and secure your chosen bakeries ahead of time. Bakery slots are highly competitive and operate strictly on a first-come, first-served basis—they go fast, so book your run early!





Volunteer Role:



Save bread!



- Choose your own runs on Breadline by selecting the bakeries you want to collect from



- Check-in for real-time updates and bring your own bags to collect



- Be agile and flexible, go to where the bread is!





Service time: Pick-up time is the one stated for your shop. You can drop-off your collection in Nan Dao Commercial Building, Sheung Wan from 8:30pm to 9:30pm. Volunteers will be there to welcome you with your haul.



If you sign up as a team, each teammate should claim their own runs. 





Service details and volunteer safety: All volunteers will receive a service reminder for this activity which must be followed exactly to ensure timely bread collection and handling guidelines are followed.

occurrences.locationZipCode: 九龍及香港島

occurrences.opportunityName: Help and Deliver Your Care at Paws United Charity Dog Adoption Centre
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Paws United Charity (PUC) is a non-profit, all-volunteer rescue organization established and registered in Hong Kong (ORG00102).

 

A group of animal-loving volunteers who are passionate about animal rescue and have worked together across various rescue projects in Hong Kong. After many years of hard work and dedication, they finally have a ‘home’ to call their own.



Volunteer roles:

1. Taking care and socializing with puppies

2. Cleansing

3. Assisting visitors by introducing Paws United Charity and the puppies to them



This will serve PUC’s core mission to continue to improve the lives of animals in our community by promoting responsible pet ownership, humane treatment of animals, and choosing adoption instead of purchase. 



Important Note: Please be aware that some dogs, particularly puppies, are very energetic and at times, boisterous. Volunteers should be comfortable handling dogs with this level of energy and enthusiasm, and we recommend wearing appropriate clothing (as detailed below) to minimise nips or scratches. 



Remarks:


	
Only successfully registered volunteers for this activity are allowed to join this activity. Please DO NOT bring any unregistered volunteers, your kids, or pets to volunteer.

	
Clothing: 
	

		
Wear something comfortable and things you don’t mind getting dirty in.

		
DO NOT wear clothes that are too loose or overly-exposed

		
NO swimwear, swim trunks, sandals, or slippers. 

	

	

	
Meals:
	

		
Please have your meal before coming as there is no meal break. We understand that the duty may be energy-consuming, but you are welcome to bring snacks/bread or small bites for a short snack break in centre.

The Amber Foundation invites you to support their “The Toiletries Project”, a key initiative dedicated to providing essential hygiene items to vulnerable and less resourced communities across Hong Kong.



Access to basic toiletries is fundamental to health, yet it remains a challenge for many. This project fills that gap by collecting, assembling, and distributing vital hygiene kits to those in looking for support, including women in shelters, domestic workers, individuals living on the streets, elderly, and refugee communities. occurrences.opportunityName: Phone call support to 1 elderly individual [PRE-TRAINED VOLUNTEERS ONLY]
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Each volunteer joining this support-program must have attended our information session before and be available to support ONE elderly individual, by making one phone call each week over a four-week period.
 
First phone calls will be made on Saturday Oct 1st—after then a suitable day and time for calling will be determined between the volunteer and the elderly person they are supporting. Once you signed up for the June 18th session, it means that you 're available for the four-week period and our staff will help you sign up for the remaining three sessions (this is important for our tracking purposes).

Description: Many elderly residents in Hong Kong struggle with social isolation, as they become disconnected from their families and communities. Without regular visitors or conversation, the effects of loneliness can be severe for this vulnerable population, including increased risk of anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline. Help from the city 's volunteers is needed to provide companionship and support for Hong Kong 's isolated elderly residents.


Volunteer roles: Each volunteer will be assigned one elderly individual to call on the phone and check in with once a week. They will provide social connection and emotional support and help their district’s elderly centre to determine their well-being and immediate needs.

All volunteers who attend this activity must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong.

occurrences.opportunityName: Re-think Plastic: Volunteer anytime anywhere to help solve excessive waste issue
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.



Volunteer hours completed through this activity may not be recognized by all schools. Students should check with their school 's coordinator.

By signing up to support one of these you commit to raising all their required items and delivering them directly to the charity—with the help of friends, neighbours or colleagues!



Please collect the suggested below items: 

 


	
Canned food 

	
Instant noodles/Dried noodles 

	
Biscuits 

	
Rice 





Volunteer roles:


 




	
Before signing up to raise the items needed below give consideration to whether you can rally your community to help you raise the items needed—we’ve seen many families, individuals and families do this successfully! Volunteers typically use their homes for storage until all items have been gathered

	
You will need to deliver your items directly to the community fridge within a week after receiving our service reminder (coming from HOHK@handsonhongkong.org). 

	
Please take a photo after putting those donated items in the fridge, and send this photo back to HOHK@handsonhongkong.org.

occurrences.opportunityName: Help and Deliver Your Care at Paws United Charity Dog Adoption Centre
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Paws United Charity (PUC) is a non-profit, all-volunteer rescue organization established and registered in Hong Kong (ORG00102).

 

A group of animal-loving volunteers who are passionate about animal rescue and have worked together across various rescue projects in Hong Kong. After many years of hard work and dedication, they finally have a ‘home’ to call their own.



Volunteer roles:

1. Taking care and socializing with puppies

2. Cleansing

3. Assisting visitors by introducing Paws United Charity and the puppies to them



This will serve PUC’s core mission to continue to improve the lives of animals in our community by promoting responsible pet ownership, humane treatment of animals, and choosing adoption instead of purchase. 



Important Note: Please be aware that some dogs, particularly puppies, are very energetic and at times, boisterous. Volunteers should be comfortable handling dogs with this level of energy and enthusiasm, and we recommend wearing appropriate clothing (as detailed below) to minimise nips or scratches. 



Remarks:


	
Only successfully registered volunteers for this activity are allowed to join this activity. Please DO NOT bring any unregistered volunteers, your kids, or pets to volunteer.

	
Clothing: 
	

		
Wear something comfortable and things you don’t mind getting dirty in.

		
DO NOT wear clothes that are too loose or overly-exposed

		
NO swimwear, swim trunks, sandals, or slippers. 

	

	

	
Meals:
	

		
Please have your meal before coming as there is no meal break. We understand that the duty may be energy-consuming, but you are welcome to bring snacks/bread or small bites for a short snack break in centre.

occurrences.opportunityName: Packing & sorting food in Tuen Mun for Hong Kong 's most vulnerable
occurrences.organizationServedName: Youth With A Mission Tuen Mun Hong Kong
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description:  Job losses and financial hardships have led to a notable rise in families seeking assistance from charities for essential food needs. YWAM Tuen Mun actively collects surplus dry and fresh food from a variety of donors, receiving both regular and ad-hoc contributions, including items nearing their shelf life and generous donations from partners.

Volunteers will conduct a thorough quality check and sorting process for these donations in the warehouse. They carefully record and evaluate how the food will be redistributed to partner charities and feeding programs that support at-risk elderly individuals, underprivileged children, and low-income families.




Volunteer roles:



	
Volunteers will attend a short briefing at the start of the session and have a clear overview of the food bank and its operations. 

	
Inventory checking, sorting food, labelling, packing items (eg. rice packing, mask packing etc), cleaning, and preparing for the food assistance programs. 



  



All volunteers who attend this activity must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. If you wish to have a friend or family member join you on this activity, they must first register with Hands On and sign up for the activity.

occurrences.opportunityName: Be a Bocce Class Assistant for People with Special Needs
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: LOVE 21 is a charity dedicated to bettering the lives of those living with Down syndrome and autism in Hong Kong through physical activity and nutrition. They run a variety of sport and exercise classes, a health and nutrition programme, and guardian counselling and workshops. 

Volunteer roles:





	
To be comfortable with playing bocce. 

	
To be able to lead a subgroup independently.

	
To assist the Sports Instructor in teaching a group of 8-12 children or people aged 6-45 and with Down Syndrome and to be confident enough to practice with the students when the coach is working with other students.

	
To assist the instructor in helping the class run smoothly and safely, while also ensuring that everyone is actively engaged.

	
To motivate and energize participants throughout the class.

	
Please wear appropriate sports clothing and footwear as you will be actively participating as well. 







Language requirements for volunteers: Fluent in Cantonese (preferred but not required) 

All volunteers who attend this activity must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. If you wish to have a friend or family member join you on this activity, they must first register with HandsOn and sign up for the activity.

Description: In Hong Kong, 3,600 tonnes of food are discarded daily, while one in five people struggles to access nutritious meals. In response to this urgent need, Feeding Hong Kong 's Bread Runs mobilise dedicated volunteers to collect surplus fresh bread and quality food from local stores near closing time. Volunteers play a crucial role in addressing hunger and reducing food waste in our community, helping us sustain this vital work.

These bread donations are redistributed the same night or first thing the following morning to local charities feeding people in need including shelters for the homeless, migrant workers, refugee support centres, children 's homes and other non-profits supporting the vulnerable.    

Volunteers will work in teams of two to support Feeding Hong Kong’s Bread Run and collect food items from a store in  AIA Tower, Fortress Hill. And then deliver these items immediately to their Yau Tong warehouse.

occurrences.opportunityName: Re-think Plastic: Volunteer anytime anywhere to help solve excessive waste issue
occurrences.organizationServedName: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Calls to reduce, reuse and recycle in Hong Kong have never been stronger. At the start of 2022, it was estimated that over 100 million pieces of plastic items had been used and disposed of by hotel quarantine guests alone. It has been predicted that by 2030, Hong Kong will be sending 4.2 billion single-use takeaway containers to landfill every year.



For Hongkongers looking to recycle in your own district, check out the GREEN @ COMMUNITY stores across the city, run by the Environmental Protection Department.  A full list of locations and addresses can be found here.



The separation and cleaning of items is a must and made easy on-site. Eight types of recyclables are accepted including paper, metals, plastics, glass bottles, certain electrical equipment, rechargeable batteries and more.



HandsOn would like to celebrate our volunteers ' recycling efforts by recognizing your time and commitment with volunteer hours! By signing up for one of the dates below you are committing to drop off your recyclables within 14 days of your registered session and send a photo to HandsOn. We will reward the volunteer hours to your account accordingly.



Remarks: Please note, you are not required to follow the stated dates and times listed in the calendar. This is for registration and recording purposes only.

occurrences.opportunityName: Save bread for the less fortunate HK Island Wednesdays (Youth Welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HKFoodWorks
occurrences.description:
Description: Everyday in Hong Kong, over 3,250 tonnes of food waste are dumped into landfills, while one in five people live in poverty and struggle to eat.





Breadline is Hong Kong’s first public digital platform for food rescue. Volunteers connect with bakeries on Breadline to rescue leftover bread using real-time updates to make every run count.





Together, we save resources from being wasted and we support the homeless; low-income families; refugees and their children and the elderly poor, by delivering bread the same night to our grassroots partners.



 Important first step: To participate, you must sign up on the Breadline platform and secure your chosen bakeries ahead of time. Bakery slots are highly competitive and operate strictly on a first-come, first-served basis—they go fast, so book your run early!





Volunteer Role:



Save bread!



- Choose your own runs on Breadline by selecting the bakeries you want to collect from



- Check-in for real-time updates and bring your own bags to collect



- Be agile and flexible, go to where the bread is!





Service time: Pick-up time is the one stated for your shop. You can drop-off your collection in Nan Dao Commercial Building, Sheung Wan from 8:30pm to 9:30pm. Volunteers will be there to welcome you with your haul.



If you sign up as a team, each teammate should claim their own runs. 





Service details and volunteer safety: All volunteers will receive a service reminder for this activity which must be followed exactly to ensure timely bread collection and handling guidelines are followed.

occurrences.locationZipCode: 九龍及香港島

occurrences.opportunityName: Deliver Necessities and Warmth to Homeless Community in Mong Kok
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: On this Mong Kok Kindness Walk, you will see a wide range of individuals in great need and serve roughly 35 people experiencing homelessness. Apart from building connections with the homeless community, you will provide and distribute snacks and necessities to people in need.

ImpactHK’s aim for these walks is to build trust through kindness. As a charity, they are on the streets at least once per day and their focus on building friendships in the hope of creating opportunities for change. In order to sustain housing and job creation initiatives by ImpactHK, we encourage each participant to donate $100 or more.

This walk starts from ImpactHK’s centre, The Guestroom, and takes 1 hour to complete.  Please bring a reusable bag to carry the items to hand out. 

Remarks: 
-Volunteers between the ages of 10 and 14 must be accompanied by an adult to join this Kindness Walk. The guardian must first sign up for this activity. After successful registration, please email hohk@handsonhongkong.org to sign the child up. 
-Volunteers between the ages of 15 and 18 who want to join the activity without an adult must obtain prior parental consent and email this to hohk@handsonhongkong.org in order to successfully register for the activity.


All volunteers must be registered with HandsOn Hong Kong. Friends or family members must also register and sign up separately.

occurrences.opportunityName: Collect Bread for Redistribution - Fortress Hill (Youth welcome)
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: In Hong Kong, 3,600 tonnes of food are discarded daily, while one in five people struggles to access nutritious meals. In response to this urgent need, Feeding Hong Kong 's Bread Runs mobilise dedicated volunteers to collect surplus fresh bread and quality food from local stores near closing time. Volunteers play a crucial role in addressing hunger and reducing food waste in our community, helping us sustain this vital work.

These bread donations are redistributed the same night or first thing the following morning to local charities feeding people in need including shelters for the homeless, migrant workers, refugee support centres, children 's homes and other non-profits supporting the vulnerable.    

Volunteers will work in teams of two to support Feeding Hong Kong’s Bread Run and collect food items from a store in  AIA Tower, Fortress Hill. And then deliver these items immediately to their Yau Tong warehouse.

occurrences.opportunityName: Help Sort through Second-hand Clothing with Environmental NGO Redress
occurrences.managingOrganization: HandsOn Hong Kong 牽手香港
occurrences.description:
Description: Did you know that in Hong Kong we dump around 400 tonnes of clothes in our landfills every day, equivalent to around 1.2 million t-shirts? There’s no getting away from it, the fashion industry is hugely polluting. 
 
Redress is a pioneering Hong Kong environmental charity with a mission to educate and empower the fashion industry and consumers to reduce clothings negative environmental impact by shifting to circular solutions. One of the ways we do this is by increasing the re-sale, re-use and recycling of clothing. Through our Clothing Takeback Programme, we collect unwanted clothing from Hong Kongers, and then carefully sort it together with volunteers in order to redistribute it for re-sale at Redress ' secondhand stores, re-use by those in need in our community through our work with 10+ local charity partners, or recycling. Our careful sorting process maximises the value of each item, better supports our charity partners by matching clothing with their specific needs, and reduces wastage.
 
As a part of the community and consumers, you can join our work in circular fashion by participating in our regular "sorting sessions ".
 
Volunteer roles:
1. Help to unbox secondhand clothing donations into the sorting area.
2. Help to carefully sort secondhand clothing donations into 15 categories based on the item 's type and condition.
3. Help to weigh boxes of sorted clothing and move them to the ‘OUT’ area.
4. Help to tidy-up the sorting area at the end of the session.
 
Remarks:
1. The duration of each session is 3 hours (including 15 mins briefing; 15 mins short break and review; 5 mins reflection)
2. Redress will provide safety and hygiene equipment (include gloves, masks, hand sanitizers, first aid kit, etc)
3. Please dress casually with closed-toe shoes and bring your own drinking water.
4. Volunteers are required to fill in the health declaration form on site.
5. Redress staff or the media may take photos or videos to record the activity for the purpose of sharing and promoting the charity’s work. Please inform a staff member on-site if you are uncomfortable with being photographed.

Remarks: Most of the charity partners are now facing a challenging funding landscape. Increased demand for services – due to funding reductions within the sector – coupled with reduced funding opportunities, from corporate engagements to grants, has created a critical need for support. Furthermore, rising operational costs, driven by inflation and other economic factors, mean that we require increased funding to simply maintain the current level of service.

Therefore, to ensure the stream of funding from engaging corporate partners and the best interactive volunteering experiences for everyone, the service sessions open at the HandsOn platform are only for individual participation.

If you and your friends from the same company wish to participate together, we recommend keeping your group size to no more than 3-5 people. Additionally, we kindly ask that you refrain from sharing or engaging in any promotional activities related to your company during the activity.

For companies ' engagement, please contact Redress directly here.
